visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In a bright indoor office environment, a group of approximately eleven people are gathered for a group photograph. The background is a plain white wall decorated with 'MERRY CHRISTMAS' letter balloons and a hanging iridescent snowflake ornament. Several individuals in the front are kneeling, including a woman in a green cardigan and a beige skirt, while others stand behind. A man in a blue hat sits centrally holding a 'WE WANT YOU' sign. They are all smiling and gesturing with their hands toward the camera. (2) The camera zooms in slightly on the right side of the group. A man in a brown patterned cardigan points both index fingers to his head while smiling broadly. Behind him, a woman with curly hair and glasses holds a red ceremonial sash with gold text, laughing along with the group. The lighting is consistent and bright, typical of a studio or office setting.

Her tone is clear, authoritative yet friendly, with a stable pitch and moderate volume. There is no background music, only a clean indoor room tone. (2) A second female voice off-camera comments, 'Hao kuai le o' (So happy), with a gentle, breathy intonation and high positive valence. (3) The photographer concludes with 'Hao, xie xie' (Okay, thank you), which triggers an immediate high-arousal collective cheer 'Yay!' from the entire group. The cheer is characterized by overlapping vocal textures and a significant swell in volume and spectral brightness.
